ideal: Every bug is filed with four parts, one rank and one type, closed in time by its merged pull request, never reopened.

sources.title: GitLab Handbook: Issue Triage, Severity SLOs
GitHub Docs: Syntax for issue forms
GitHub Docs: Linking a pull request to an issue
Kubernetes community: Issue triage guidelines, Define priority

quality: Every open issue has four parts, one P and one type; a merged pull request closes it for good; every label is used.
speed: No open issue idles 60 days or outlives its rank close target, and the Public launch milestone empties before the make-public gate.
consumption: The daily read stays a short lane: a few calls per 100 issues, within 5 job minutes.
